#!/bin/ash
# Tidy Installation Script
# Server Files Path: /mnt/server

PROJECT=tidy

cd /mnt/server

if which tidy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo -e "[✓] Tidy is already pre-installed in the container image!"
else
    # Fallback for standard Yolks images: download static binary
    apk update && apk add --no-cache curl jq git
    GITHUB_REPO="Kenzi-Siaufandi/tidy"

    if [ "${TIDY_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${TIDY_VERSION}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest" |
            jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name=="tidy") | .browser_download_url')
        if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
            DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest/download/tidy"
        fi
    else
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/download/${TIDY_VERSION}/tidy"
    fi

    echo -e "Downloading Tidy from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
    curl -sSL -o tidy "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || echo -e "[!] Note: Please upload the tidy binary manually if release is not yet published."

    if [ -f tidy ]; then
        chmod +x tidy
        echo -e "[✓] Tidy downloaded successfully!"
    fi
fi
